group UserCreate:User.create form [page/UserCreate/view/form/create/User]
  case roles(admin) / access-allowed
    expect: outcome=allowed; enforcement=authoritative
    must not: (none declared)
    fact: fact/page/UserCreate/view/form/create/User/access/allowed/admin
  case anonymous / access-denied
    expect: outcome=denied; enforcement=authoritative
    must not: (none declared)
    fact: fact/page/UserCreate/view/form/create/User/access/denied/anonymous
  case observable-feedback / observable-feedback
    expect: feedback=invalid,failure
    must not: (none declared)
    fact: fact/page/UserCreate/view/form/create/User/feedback

group UserCreate:User.create submit [page/UserCreate/view/form/create/User/submit]
  case roles(admin) / access-allowed
    expect: outcome=allowed; enforcement=authoritative
    must not: (none declared)
    fact: fact/page/UserCreate/view/form/create/User/submit/access/allowed/admin
  case anonymous / access-denied
    expect: outcome=denied; enforcement=authoritative
    must not: (none declared)
    fact: fact/page/UserCreate/view/form/create/User/submit/access/denied/anonymous
  case mutation-accepted / mutation-accepted
    expect: outcome=accepted; stored=input
    must not: (none declared)
    fact: fact/page/UserCreate/view/form/create/User/submit/mutation/accepted
  case mutation-at-most-once / mutation-at-most-once
    expect: outcome=accepted-once; applied-mutations=1
    must not: (none declared)
    fact: fact/page/UserCreate/view/form/create/User/submit/mutation/at-most-once
  case navigation / navigation
    expect: navigation.success=page:UserDetail
    must not: (none declared)
    fact: fact/page/UserCreate/view/form/create/User/submit/navigation
  case matches User.email / validation-rejected
    expect: outcome=rejected; preserve-input=User.name,User.team
    must not: stored data changed
    fact: fact/page/UserCreate/view/form/create/User/submit/validation/matches/email/constraint/type/Email/constraint/matches
  case required User.email / validation-rejected
    expect: outcome=rejected; preserve-input=User.name,User.team
    must not: stored data changed
    fact: fact/page/UserCreate/view/form/create/User/submit/validation/required/email
  case required User.name / validation-rejected
    expect: outcome=rejected; preserve-input=User.email,User.team
    must not: stored data changed
    fact: fact/page/UserCreate/view/form/create/User/submit/validation/required/name
  case unique User.email / validation-rejected
    expect: outcome=rejected; preserve-input=User.name,User.email,User.team
    must not: stored data changed
    fact: fact/page/UserCreate/view/form/create/User/submit/validation/unique/email
